defect.rootCause: _scheduleAuthoritativeShutdown() considered verifying/authoritative-only states but ignored state.authoritativeRequests, allowing the idle timer to terminate the authoritative worker during an unverified bootstrap conversion for a new calculation day.

fix.behavior: An idle-shutdown timer now treats any non-empty state.authoritativeRequests map as an in-flight authoritative request, defers termination, and reschedules the idle check. Normal idle termination is preserved.

distribution.reason: Locked esbuild dependency is not present; npm ci cannot complete because the execution environment has no usable outbound DNS/network.
